idea-plugin.name: Flutter Debug MCP
idea-plugin.description: Native Streamable HTTP Flutter MCP server: DTD discovery, IDE run control, hot reload/restart, runtime navigation, bounded logs and VM events, DevTools, breakpoints, stepping, object inspection and Flutter service extensions. Includes permission settings and private operation audit. Server disabled by default.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Adds system deep links and debug navigation for running Flutter sessions.
  • Supports Windows Android SDK discovery, IDE paths, and account-private storage for credentials and audit logs.
  • Uses platform-specific build defaults for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
